z80c02_assay_L16.note: Algocell's assay executor (z80_test_L16.wgsl and its traced and op-traced derivations) as a Zilion machine: the Zilion 0.2.0 Z80 (compat '0.2'), tapes A, B of 16 bytes on a ring of 32, SP aliasing the last byte of B, a per-lane step budget, the opcode-suppression table in the uniform (Algocell's params.suppress layout), writes per tape, and the fetch and start maps.

z80c02_assay_lethal_L16.note: z80c02_assay_L16 under the lethal-tar rule (Stage I; z80_test_lethal_L16.wgsl): a zero byte fetched as the first byte of an instruction halts the lane.

z80c02_assay_lethal_L32.note: z80c02_assay_L32 under the lethal-tar rule (Stage I; z80_test_lethal_L32.wgsl): a zero byte fetched as the first byte of an instruction halts the lane.

m6502_assay_L16.note: The NMOS 6502 of zilion next (validated per instruction against SingleStepTests 6502/v1; experimental status) in the assay world: tapes A, B of 16 bytes on a ring of 32, the first push landing on the last byte of B (S = 0xFF), P = 0x20, every other register zero, PC = 0, a per-lane step budget, writes per tape, and the fetch and start maps. No ablation table (Algocell's suppression masks are Z80 opcode pages). For the assay plumbing; no 6502 result may be drawn from it before the 6502 pre-registration.
